title: Iki environment image binding (iki/v1)
description: An image supplied by this deployment for a plugin environment and a range of that plugin's releases.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this manifest follows.

plugin_version.description: The plugin releases this image supports, as comma-separated comparisons such as `>=1.2,<2`.

pull_secret.description: The name of a Kubernetes image pull secret in the namespace where runs start.
